method: Fixed 742-address intersection (483 EOAs + 259 storage contracts) present byte-identical in every state, sampled via proof_getProofWithMeta. mainnet @24954458, x3.5 = PRISTINE @24358000, x5 = rebloat @24546596, x7 = exact-7× @24641589. Seed 27 (state-benchmarks issue #27).
storageLabel: account + 1-slot storage proof, total bytes p50
crossClient: Witness bytes are client-agnostic — EIP-1186 proofs are byte-identical across clients for the same state root. Verified Geth v1.17.3 vs Nethermind at 3.5× (per-proof Δ = 0); holds structurally through 7×. Besu / Reth / Erigon use the same fixed address set; pending.
finding: Typical witness depth stays at 8 levels across all milestones — individual proofs barely grow (+8–9% to 7× on EOA account bytes, ~+1–2% per step beyond 5×). A 16-slot combined witness is ~24.6 KB at 7× (22.9 KB mainnet) — a slow, near-linear creep, not a blow-up. The per-block witness cost is dominated by how much state is touched, not by individual proof size.
note: 1× / 3.5× / 5× / 7× are measured on the same address set and are directly comparable. 10× is pending.
